implementation: v0.3.0 Windows native CPU and CUDA registration

case.note: Four non-expert head landmarks; exploratory numerical check, not a clinical quality target

recipe.purpose: Full-resolution brain MRI performance: controlled dense variant of pinned antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t s; not the unmodified stock preset

intentional_deviations: linear dense sampling instead of Regular 0.25
one final warped image for both engines; no inverse-warped intensity image
source_recipe.scope: current independently implemented CPU FP64 options only; stock preset retained separately

source_line_endings.measured: Raw working-tree bytes retained in runtime_sha256
source_line_endings.packaged: Git LF source bytes retained in packaged_runtime_sha256
source_line_endings.runtime_equivalence: Path.read_text normalizes CRLF before CUDA compilation; the compiled header text is unchanged

measurement_scope: Fresh target process startup/imports, image reads, registration, GPU synchronization, built-in QA and final writes; runner startup excluded
qa_timing_asymmetry: Fast ANTs includes built-in output QA; official ANTs omits that additional QA; no time subtraction
cold_scope: Empty task-owned CuPy, driver and Numba caches; filesystem input/page caches and system GPU state are not reset
warmup_policy: One full excluded run for each Fast ANTs backend; shared compiled caches for formal runs; no full official ANTs warmup
formal_order: CUDA FP32, CPU FP32, CPU FP64, ANTs FP32, ANTs FP64; reverse order for repeat 2
statistics_scope: Median of two serial fresh-process measurements per engine on one native MRI pair
background_scope: Temperature and background load were not fixed; no system power settings were changed

writing.fast_ants: Python gzip level 0, one writer thread per file; built-in QA included
writing.official_ants: Native Windows writer defaults; no additional Fast ANTs QA
